statement: Under a fixed charged-training-seconds budget, any FLOP removed from the forward/backward pass is converted into additional optimizer steps, so a change is only worthwhile if the quality it costs per step is smaller than the quality the extra steps buy.

scope.model: decoder-only transformer, 8 layers, d_model 512, 4 heads of 128
scope.budget: 300 charged training seconds on one H200

locators.excerpt: TIME_BUDGET = 300        # training time budget in seconds (5 minutes)

metrics.name: val_bpb
metrics.result: Directly implied by the scope: budget.kind is training_seconds, not num_steps. Prior campaigns on this benchmark family measured roughly -0.0006 val_bpb per +1% steps, which sets the exchange rate a FLOP-saving change must beat.
